DECLARE
BEGIN
  FOR r IN (
    SELECT T1.TEMPLATE_TYPE_CODE AS TEMPLATE_TYPE_CODE,

BEGIN
  FOR r IN (
    SELECT T1.DOCUMENT_ID AS document_id,

END;

    SELECT T1.PROFESSIONAL_ID, MAX(T1.CELL_NUMBER) AS CELL_NUMBER
    FROM DOG_KENNELS.PROFESSIONALS T1
    JOIN DOG_KENNELS.TREATMENTS T2
      ON T1.PROFESSIONAL_ID = T2.PROFESSIONAL_ID
    GROUP BY T1.PROFESSIONAL_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN c LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(r.PROFESSIONAL_ID || ',' || r.CELL_NUMBER);
  END LOOP;
END;
/

question:

- Format TIMESTAMP values as YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.

reference_answer:
DECLARE
  CURSOR c_profs IS
    SELECT professional_id, last_name, cell_number
    FROM dog_kennels.professionals
    WHERE state = 'Indiana'
    UNION
    SELECT t1.professional_id, t1.last_name, t1.cell_number
    FROM dog_kennels.professionals t1
    JOIN dog_kennels.treatments t2
      ON t1.professional_id = t2.professional_id
    GROUP BY t1.professional_id, t1.last_name, t1.cell_number
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN c_profs LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(r.professional_id || ',' || r.last_name || ',' || r.cell_number);
  END LOOP;
END;
/
gold_sql_query: SELECT PROFESSIONAL_ID, LAST_NAME, CELL_NUMBER FROM DOG_KENNELS.PROFESSIONALS WHERE STATE = 'Indiana' UNION SELECT T1.PROFESSIONAL_ID, T1.LAST_NAME, T1.CELL_NUMBER FROM DOG_KENNELS.PROFESSIONALS T1 JOIN DOG_KENNELS.TREATMENTS T2 ON T1.PROFESSIONAL_ID = T2.PROFESSIONAL_ID GROUP BY T1.PROFESSIONAL_ID, T1.LAST_NAME, T1.CELL_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 2

question:
Which dogs are of the rarest breed? Show their names and treatment dates.
Write PL/SQL code that answers this query.

Output requirements:
- Produce result rows only with DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE; do not use RETURN, OUT parameters, ref cursors, OPEN ... FOR, PIPE ROW, SELECT output, table writes, or any other output channel as the final answer.
- Print no headers, labels, trailers, summaries, or explanatory text.
- Print exactly one output line per result row.
- For multi-column rows, separate fields only with commas; do not use spaces, tabs, pipes, semicolons, or JSON/list formatting as delimiters.
- For single-column rows, print only the value.
- Format DATE values as YYYY-MM-DD.
- Format TIMESTAMP values as YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.
- Print string field values exactly as text without surrounding single quotes or double quotes.
reference_answer:
DECLARE
  v_breed_code DOG_KENNELS.DOGS.BREED_CODE%TYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT breed_code
  INTO v_breed_code
  FROM (
    SELECT breed_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM DOG_KENNELS.DOGS
    GROUP BY breed_code
    ORDER BY cnt ASC
  )
  WHERE ROWNUM = 1;

  FOR rec IN (
    SELECT t1.name AS name, t2.date_of_treatment AS date_of_treatment
    FROM DOG_KENNELS.DOGS t1
    JOIN DOG_KENNELS.TREATMENTS t2 ON t1.dog_id = t2.dog_id
    WHERE t1.breed_code = v_breed_code
    ORDER BY t1.name, t2.date_of_treatment
  )
  LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(rec.name || ',' || TO_CHAR(rec.date_of_treatment, 'YYYY-MM-DD'));
  END LOOP;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    NULL;
END;
/
gold_sql_query: SELECT T1.NAME, T2.DATE_OF_TREATMENT FROM DOG_KENNELS.DOGS T1 JOIN DOG_KENNELS.TREATMENTS T2 ON T1.DOG_ID = T2.DOG_ID WHERE T1.BREED_CODE = (SELECT BREED_CODE FROM DOG_KENNELS.DOGS GROUP BY BREED_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)

  v_count NUMBER;
BEGIN
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
  FROM (
    SELECT t1.NAME
    FROM WORLD_1.COUNTRY t1
    JOIN WORLD_1.COUNTRYLANGUAGE t2 ON t1.CODE = t2.COUNTRYCODE
    WHERE t2.LANGUAGE = 'English'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT t1.NAME
    FROM WORLD_1.COUNTRY t1
    JOIN WORLD_1.COUNTRYLANGUAGE t2 ON t1.CODE = t2.COUNTRYCODE
    WHERE t2.LANGUAGE = 'Dutch'
  );
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('COUNT,' || v_count);
END;
/

BEGIN

END;

DECLARE
BEGIN
  FOR r IN (
    SELECT countrycode,
           MAX(language) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY percentage) AS lang,
           MAX(percentage) AS max_percentage
    FROM world_1.countrylanguage
    GROUP BY countrycode
    ORDER BY countrycode
  )
  LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(r.countrycode || ',' || r.lang || ',' || r.max_percentage);
  END LOOP;
END;
/

reference_answer:
DECLARE
  CURSOR c_visitors IS
    SELECT t1.name
    FROM museum_visit.visitor t1
    JOIN museum_visit.visit t2 ON t1.id = t2.visitor_id
    JOIN museum_visit.museum t3 ON t3.museum_id = t2.museum_id
    WHERE t3.open_year < 2009
    INTERSECT
    SELECT t1.name
    FROM museum_visit.visitor t1
    JOIN museum_visit.visit t2 ON t1.id = t2.visitor_id
    JOIN museum_visit.museum t3 ON t3.museum_id = t2.museum_id
    WHERE t3.open_year > 2011;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN c_visitors LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(r.name);
  END LOOP;
END;
/
gold_sql_query: SELECT T1.NAME FROM MUSEUM_VISIT.VISITOR T1 JOIN MUSEUM_VISIT.VISIT T2 ON T1.ID  =  T2.VISITOR_ID JOIN MUSEUM_VISIT.MUSEUM T3 ON T3.MUSEUM_ID  =  T2.MUSEUM_ID WHERE T3.OPEN_YEAR  <  2009 INTERSECT SELECT T1.NAME FROM MUSEUM_VISIT.VISITOR T1 JOIN MUSEUM_VISIT.VISIT T2 ON T1.ID  =  T2.VISITOR_ID JOIN MUSEUM_VISIT.MUSEUM T3 ON T3.MUSEUM_ID  =  T2.MUSEUM_ID WHERE T3.OPEN_YEAR  >  2011

DECLARE
  v_name ORCHESTRA.CONDUCTOR.NAME%TYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT T1.NAME
  INTO v_name
  FROM ORCHESTRA.CONDUCTOR T1
  JOIN ORCHESTRA.ORCHESTRA T2
    ON T1.CONDUCTOR_ID = T2.CONDUCTOR_ID
  GROUP BY T1.NAME
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    NULL;
END;

question:
Which countries in europe have at least 3 car manufacturers?
Write PL/SQL code that answers this query.

- Format TIMESTAMP values as YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.

reference_answer:
BEGIN
  FOR r IN (
    SELECT t1.countryname
    FROM car_1.countries t1
    JOIN car_1.continents t2 ON t1.continent = t2.contid
    JOIN car_1.car_makers t3 ON t1.countryid = t3.country
    WHERE t2.continent = 'europe'
    GROUP BY t1.countryname
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
    ORDER BY t1.countryname
  ) LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(r.countryname);
  END LOOP;
END;

BEGIN

    WITH FIRST_QUERY AS (
      SELECT T1.ID, T1.MAKER

    INTERSECT

DECLARE
  v_name EMPLOYEE_HIRE_EVALUATION.EMPLOYEE.NAME%TYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT name
  INTO v_name
  FROM (
    SELECT t1.name
    FROM EMPLOYEE_HIRE_EVALUATION.EMPLOYEE t1
    JOIN EMPLOYEE_HIRE_EVALUATION.EVALUATION t2
      ON t1.employee_id = t2.employee_id
    GROUP BY t1.name
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  )
  WHERE ROWNUM = 1;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(v_name);
END;

END;

BEGIN
  SELECT LISTAGG(area_code, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY area_code)
    INTO v_result

      JOIN VOTER_1.VOTES T2
        ON T1.CONTESTANT_NUMBER = T2.CONTESTANT_NUMBER
      JOIN VOTER_1.AREA_CODE_STATE T3
        ON T2.STATE = T3.STATE
     WHERE T1.CONTESTANT_NAME = 'Tabatha Gehling'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT T3.AREA_CODE
      FROM VOTER_1.CONTESTANTS T1
      JOIN VOTER_1.VOTES T2
        ON T1.CONTESTANT_NUMBER = T2.CONTESTANT_NUMBER
      JOIN VOTER_1.AREA_CODE_STATE T3
        ON T2.STATE = T3.STATE
     WHERE T1.CONTESTANT_NAME = 'Kelly Clauss'
  );

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(NVL(v_result, ''));
END;

DECLARE

    SELECT ROUND(AVG(t2.ranking), 1) AS avg_ranking,
           t1.first_name

      JOIN wta_1.rankings t2

    );
  END LOOP;
END;
